request.questionText: In 1990, the United Nations created a single measure that ranges between zero and one -- the Human Development Index (HDI) -- to summarize health, education, and economic status for world countries. Below is the equation for a fitted model to predict response variable HDI in terms of two predictor variables: Life expectancy and average years of School. HDI = -0.34 + (0.01 * Life) + (0.02 * School) + E Which of the following is an accurate interpretation of the coefficient for Life expectancy? Select all correct answers.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The change in HDI associated with a one-year increase in Life expectancy, holding other predictors constant.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The overall relationship between Life expectancy and HDI.

choices.label: C
choices.text: For every one-year increase in Life expectancy, we expect HDI to increase by 0.01 (irrespective of years of School).

choices.label: D
choices.text: A partial slope representing the relationship between Life expectancy and HDI, adjusting for average years of School.
